about.title: About Me
about.description: Discover who I am, my passions, and the journey that has shaped me. Learn about my background and my interests.
about.presentation: Hi, I'm Agon Kolgeci, a software developer currently studying in Computer Science. Since I was young, I've been able to discover, learn and experiment with various technologies on a self-taught basis, which has enabled me to develop a real passion for IT and acquire a variety of skills in this field. All my experiences motivated me to continue my studies in this field to deepen my knowledge and become an expert capable of creating innovative solutions. Today, I'm determined to continue on this path and improve every day to achieve my goals.

unige-events.title: UNIGE Events
unige-events.description: A university capstone project developed at the University of Geneva (UNIGE). It is a centralized web platform designed for students and campus associations to create, share, and register for campus events, built on a modern microservices architecture.
unige-events.summary: Team capstone project for the Bachelor: a web platform where students and associations publish campus events and sign up for them. Microservices architecture.

redcap-swisscom-module.title: REDCap HUG Module
redcap-swisscom-module.description: As part of a semester project, I contributed to the development of a REDCap module integrating SMS delivery through the Swisscom API. The main objective was to provide a seamless user experience while optimizing sending costs and improving the management of delivery receipts.
redcap-swisscom-module.summary: Semester project: a REDCap module for the HUG that sends SMS through the Swisscom API, with lower sending costs and better delivery receipt tracking.

swerc2024.title: SWERC 2024
swerc2024.description: SWERC is a 5-hour programming contest for teams of three students, focused on algorithmic problem solving and practical coding. This competition serves as the regional selection phase for the Europe Championship and the International Collegiate Programming Contest.
swerc2024.summary: 5-hour algorithmic contest for teams of three, a qualifier for the European Championship and the ICPC.
